title: ID0419251-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/R3170001706] Screen damage
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
I would like to report a visual defect observed on one of our chargers. The LCD screen appears to be damaged, with color distortions visible across the display. This issue could be related to wear over time or exposure to heat. At this stage, I do not wish to replace the screen, but I would like to officially document the issue and escalate it to the regional team, who will assess the situation and decide whether a replacement is necessary. Please register this ticket for traceability purposes.
